# AWS CodeDeploy

Store applications, deployment configurations and deployment groups without running deployments or agents.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `codedeploy` |
| Signing name | `codedeploy` |
| Wire protocol | AWS JSON 1.1 |
| API version | `2014-10-06` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Configuration records only |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#aws-codedeploy) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- No CreateDeployment/GetDeployment/ListDeployments/BatchGetDeployments or fake Succeeded executions; no agents, lifecycle hook execution, traffic shifts or IAM permission evaluation.
- No application revision registry, deployment targets/instances, GitHub token management, on-premises instance registration or stop/continue deployment APIs.
- Zonal configurations, trigger configurations, termination hooks, outdated-instance strategies and tag sets are excluded and fail explicitly.
- LoadBalancerInfo supports ECS targetGroupPairInfoList only; blue/green configuration supports deployment ready and original-instance termination metadata only; Server load balancers and green fleet provisioning are excluded.
- Referenced IAM roles, Auto Scaling groups, ECS services, alarms and load balancers are metadata and are not created or looked up; optional tag values default to empty.
- Native tag pagination is excluded; built-in config IDs and creation times are omitted rather than fabricated.
- CloudFormation Deployment and other excluded declared properties fail explicitly; removing a load balancer or blue/green configuration fails explicitly. CloudFormation group ApplicationName/DeploymentGroupName and application name/compute-platform changes replace; all config changes replace.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
